review_description: Installer is very knowledgeable and helped design my solar system with 40 x 400w panels. As they are on different directions, went with two inverters(15K + 5K). Installation was smooth although I would have appreciated if they have not pulled the wire into my open roof in first floor rumpus room. I also got better deal on Solar Analytics installation. They also helped organise the grid connection which was quite useful.Overall, it is a good experience. I get about 11KW max on sunny days in this Sydney weather itself. Thank you Mr. Paul.

The sales representative was very friendly and helpful with presentation advice and information to my requirement.The installation team was on time and prompt to begin the process on installing the solar system.Customer service arranged for the supply of documantion to the connection company. Would recommend this company to others to arrange their solar requirements.
It's all in the sale? Tech jargon, break it down to laymans terms.
Did the job within 1 wk..company to recommend
Great response from Green home solar. Paul was a nice guy to deal with  good advise on quality products that have good warranty.

Unfortunately, the system quoted was unable to be installed for technical reasons. It was reduced by two panels. However, the installer originally rejected my claim for a refund.It was not until I complained to the installer, then followed by a complaint to Solar Quotes, that the installer agreed to refund the difference in the cost of the system.I must say, I am extremely happy with the support provided by Solar Quotes through the whole process and will be recommending my daughter proceed with quote requests via Solarquotes for her new install.
We were happy with the product & install quality and very happy with the performance, however the communication could have been better.
Paul was so amazing. He explained everything very clearly and answered all my questions patiently. You can tell he is passionate about solar!

I am extremely happy with the final product installation. A 6Kw system with a Fronius inverter and 20 LG 330 watt panels. Although panels were installed early December ,the job was finally finished towards the end of February when the C.C.E.W paperwork was forwarded to my electrical supplier. I would suggest not to have a installation too close to Christmas.. as  problems that could arise (and did ) that were out of Green Homes contol, could not be rectified by the Green Home until later in the new year. I'm looking forward to receiving my next electrcity bill and seeing if it was all worth while .Thanks again Paul.

Paul from Green Home Sustainability Assessors Pty Ltd was the only salesman to actually come to my house to do the quote and to explain what the process would be. Installation took place within a week. The inverter quoted on was not available so Paul substituted a higher level Fronius inverter at no extra cost. The electrician completed the wiring to the power box on the same day so we were generating power on the same day the panels and inverter were installed. Very impressed by Paul and the team of workers who very efficiently installed everything. Glad SolarQuotes recommended them.
